shown_evidence.subject: Capture wrapper and limits
shown_evidence.detail: Read complete capture_baseline.py. It refreshes pinned source constraints, checks existing CLI digest, exclusively creates output directory, uses an isolated private CLI config and exactly seven known IDs with accepted metadata.capture_format. Each of two calls has timeout min(10, remaining total30), bounded output and sanitized environment for CLI process. Default without exact --capture-once does not call capture. Native call count and timing are parent/code reports, not independent reviewer observation.
